svg.title: How Hephaestus decides whether a change made your agent better
svg.desc: Six steps. 1, write the agent: a Genome is the agent's sealed recipe. 2, set the rules: a World is the exam, its limits, and what is forbidden. 3, try a change: a child Genome remembers its parent. 4, fair fight: the Arena runs old and new on the same tasks in separate sandboxes. 5, sealed judge: an Evaluator the agents can never read scores both. 6, write it down: the verdict is a receipt in a tamper-evident Ledger, and a clear winner can become Champion.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
